info.name: tony's workshop
info.description: This Stylish theme transforms your browser into a dark, high-tech interface inspired by Iron Man’s HUD. It sets your uploaded image as the background, ensuring a perfect fit. The deep black and dark gray color scheme creates a modern, cinematic look, while neon cyan highlights give interactive elements a sleek, glowing effect. Transparent panels and menus resemble a glass-like interface, enhancing immersion. Buttons and links feature subtle hover effects for a dynamic feel. A sleek, modern font ensures readability, and the scrollbar is redesigned to blend seamlessly. This J.A.R.V.I.S.-like theme delivers a tech-savvy, cyberpunk browsing experience.
